name: 3DOS
desc: 3DOS is developing customizable, 3D-printed scaffolds that repair and regenerate bone in oral, maxillofacial, and orthopedic trauma surgery. Its biodegradable scaffolds use biocompatible materials and structures optimized to maximize bone regrowth, in an easy-to-use format designed to outperform existing products.
summary: Customizable, 3D-printed biodegradable scaffolds for bone repair and regeneration.
